Entry Level

Everlaw is a litigation and investigation management platform that uses AI to help legal teams analyze large volumes of electronic evidence. The Software Engineer will build and deploy end-to-end product features, collaborate across teams, improve platform reliability, and contribute to documentation and knowledge-sharing.
Cloud Computing
Enterprise Software
Legal
Document Management
Ediscovery
Legal Tech

No H1B
Unicorn with $2B valuation
Responsibilities
Build new product features end-to-end, taking projects from initial architectural design through implementation and deployment
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Developer Operations to design, build, and launch functionality seamlessly
Maintain and improve the reliability of our platform by debugging complex issues across a large-scale codebase
Contribute to system documentation and team knowledge-sharing to keep our codebase easy to navigate and maintain
Partner with your dedicated onboarding mentor to ramp up quickly on our platform architecture, development practices, and product domains

Compiled programming languages C++
Compiled programming languages Java

Required
You have a BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent coursework
You have experience and proficiency in coding in a compiled language (C++, Java, etc) and scripting language (Python, JavaScript, etc)
You have a strong foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, algorithms, and data structures
You've built and delivered software projects through class assignments, personal projects, or internships
You bring strong strategic thinking and a collaborative approach to solving complex technical problems
You are authorized to work in the United States
Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role
Preferred
You are familiar with Linux operating systems and environments
You have hands-on experience using Git or a similar version control system
You have strong written and verbal communication skills
You have held a campus leadership position or completed a technical research program
Benefits
This role is also eligible for equity
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

Company-sponsored life and disability insurance
Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long-term growth
401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation
17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave
Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company-wide days off) per year
Annual allocation for learning & development and relevant professional membership dues
Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life's logistics
Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup
Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices
